strategies.name: ict_bias_aligned_stop_raid_mss_pd_array_retracement
strategies.entry_summary: After establishing higher-timeframe bias, wait for a liquidity raid/stop run, then a market structure shift/displacement in the intended direction. Enter on the retracement into discount/premium or OTE at a PD array such as a fair value gap, order block, breaker block, or box setup confluence.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the invalidation swing or PD-array boundary (for longs, below the low/order block; for shorts, above the high/order block). Take a first partial at opposing liquidity or a nearby objective, then either move stop to breakeven and hold for further liquidity targets/new highs or-l

strategies.name: box_setup_deviation_retest_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: When price deviates below a range low and reclaims back into the range, treat it as a box setup/accumulation-manipulation-distribution pattern. Enter on the retest of the manipulation area, looking for price to travel to the opposite side of the range.
strategies.exit_summary: Take partial profits as price moves higher and use the opposite-side liquidity above the range as the main target. The transcript does not give a precise stop placement rule beyond using the manipulated area as the retest/invalidation zone.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Requires deviation below range, reclaim into range, then retest of the manipulation before continuation
variants.target_note: Take partials, then target liquidity resting above the range
variants.transcript_quote: ideally I'm looking for a retest of this manipulation to then be reaching for the other side here before going higher

result.enumeration_note: Enumerated two strategies: the main ICT stop-raid plus MSS retracement model, and a separate box-setup deviation-retest reversal. Directional long/short uses of the main model are treated as compatible variants of one skeleton, while the box setup is separate because the speaker explicitly notes it can trigger without the prior structure-shift requirement.
